market: BUF −3, total 44.5. Allen 30.5 attempts / 20 completions and 7.5 rushes; Wentz 30.5 / 19.5. James Cook 18.5 carries; Jordan Mason 11.5; Aaron Jones 8.5.
lineup: MIN ruled out Kyler Murray (hamstring) on Thursday, so Carson Wentz starts; WR Jauan Jennings is also out. BUF WR Joshua Palmer and CB Jordan Hancock are out; OTs Dion Dawkins and Alec Anderson are questionable. Final actives post Monday about 5:45 PM CT. Re-check before trading.
branches: If both BUF tackles sit, MIN's blitz gets home faster, which helps any Allen-under or sack-driven read and hurts Allen's passing.

keys.how: Pressure on almost every snap. MIN blitzes 72.8% of dropbacks, by far the most in the league, and allows 13.3 points a game, the fewest.
keys.gives: Man coverage with defenders' backs to the QB. When the blitz is picked up, a QB who runs gets open grass (Allen scrambled 8 times for 121 yards against LA).
keys.counter: BUF runs Cook (20 carries, 101 yards a game) at a defense allowing 4.58 yards per carry, and throws quick passes to Shakir and Kincaid.

keys.take: Justin Jefferson. In Wentz's two starts he had 39% and 32% of the targets.
keys.how: BUF allows 154 WR yards a game, but opponents throw 38 times a game against BUF because they're trailing.
keys.gives: TE work. BUF allows 9.1 TE targets and 70.6 TE yards a game.
keys.counter: MIN's run-first approach (45.8% neutral pass rate). Wentz threw only 19–20 times in his two wins.

scripts.control: BUF leads. Wentz throws 30+ times for the first time this season, so Jefferson and Hockenson get more volume, but against the defense that has allowed the most pass attempts. Allen's runs become kneel-downs.
scripts.competitive: A grinding Monday game with MIN's defense keeping it close. Allen's designed runs in the red zone matter most here.
scripts.reversal: MIN leads behind its defense, as in Wentz's 39–22 and 9–3 wins. Allen chases against the blitz, his scramble-heavy scenario.

plays.cond: Only if Dawkins plays. Becomes a final line at 46¢ or less.
plays.why: MIN has contained every QB but one, and Allen's big rushing games have been scramble-driven, which needs the blitz to break down.
plays.support: QBs facing MIN: Love 0, Caleb 42, Mayfield 6, Willis 11, Shough 0, Jones 13, Goff 2. Only one reached 30.
plays.sample: Allen went 30+ in 3 of 7 (72, 121, 30). Four of his seven games were 24 or less.
plays.counter: MIN's 72.8% blitz rate creates the exact escape lanes Allen uses. This is the doc's open question: does he cross the line or extend to throw?
plays.loses: A 15-yard scramble on third down plus a couple of red-zone keepers. Two plays can do it.
plays.vs: Preferred over under 25 (No 39¢), which loses to a normal Allen game, and under 40 (No 67¢), which is priced past what his 2 of 7 at 40+ supports.

value: Josh Allen under 30 rushing yards (No) at 48¢ (needs 50%, our number 48–58%)

passed.name: James Cook 80+ rush (53¢), either side
passed.why: He's gone 80+ in 5 of 7, but MIN holds lead backs to 4.58 yards per carry and our backtest leans No. They cancel.

passed.name: Carson Wentz under 200 pass yds (No 44¢)
passed.why: He threw for 133 and 143 in his starts, but those were MIN-led games on 19–20 attempts, and BUF opponents throw 38 times a game.
passed.move: BUF's tackles both out (more sacks, shorter drives).

passed.name: Justin Jefferson 80+ (50¢)
passed.why: His share with Wentz is high, but he has topped 80 once in six games.

passed.name: T.J. Hockenson 40+ (54¢)
passed.why: BUF is soft against TEs (70.6 yards a game), but he went 36 and 29 with Wentz.

sources.t: AP via WAFB — Vikings sit Murray, will start Wentz (Nov 5)
